## Module Overview

### Module summary

Set up study areas and parameters for LandWeb simulations.

### Events

```{r eventFlowCheck-LandWeb-preamble, include = FALSE, eval = TRUE, cache = FALSE}
## the generated figures need SpaDES.core 3.2.1.9068 or later; older versions skip them
.efOK <- utils::packageVersion("SpaDES.core") >= "3.2.1.9068"
```

```{r eventFlow-LandWeb-preamble, echo = FALSE, eval = .efOK, cache = FALSE, out.width = "100%", fig.pos = "H", fig.cap = "(ref:LandWeb-preamble) events, as read from the module code with its default parameters."}
ef <- tryCatch(SpaDES.core::moduleEventFlow("LandWeb_preamble", path = ".."), error = function(e) e)
SpaDES.core::includeModuleEventFlow(ef, "figures/LandWeb_preamble_eventFlow.png")
```

```{r eventObjects-LandWeb-preamble, echo = FALSE, eval = .efOK, cache = FALSE}
SpaDES.core::kableModuleObjects(ef, caption = "Where each object of (ref:LandWeb-preamble) is written and read, in run order.",
                                lead = "Table \\@ref(tab:eventObjects-LandWeb-preamble) lists, for each object, the code that writes it and the code that only reads it.")
```

```{r eventFigures-LandWeb-preamble, echo = FALSE, eval = .efOK, cache = FALSE, results = "asis"}
SpaDES.core::moduleEventFigures(ef, figDir = "figures", level = 4)
```
